frozen_geometry: For each crater, use a 1.5-3.0 crater-radius annulus and a 10-degree half-width ray sector centered on the great-circle bearing to Aristarchus Plateau; pool equal-width flanks centered 30 degrees to either side.
frozen_primary_oracle: Each local contrast >= 0.05; similarity ratio >= 0.75; Glushko local contrast > Ohm local contrast.
stop_rule: Stop before WAC values if transcript identity, target coordinates, symmetric geometry, exact 566 nm products, or thresholds cannot be verified from non-outcome sources.
